run_fairscore_evaluation: run the fairscore evaluation script with a pretrained model on perturbed and unperturbed dataset examples
compute_metrics_fairscore: compute fairscore metrics by comparing model predictions on perturbed versus unperturbed examples and aggregating results
compute_fairscore: compute fairscore by comparing perturbed and unperturbed predictions to measure model fairness across both example types
run_main_evaluation_pipeline: run the main evaluation pipeline that loads a model, formats datasets, and evaluates with FairscoreTrainerEvalOnly
review_fairscore_trainer_setup: review the FairscoreTrainerEvalOnly setup with custom data collators for multiple choice and sequence classification tasks
